text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In such a pathetic state,
I can't face the Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I thought I had more respect
for the horse girls than anyone else..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'm all talk and haven't accomplished anything at all...
At this rate, I can't even call myself a fan...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: I know how serious you are.
I know very well how serious you are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Really...?
Am I... doing my best for my oshi...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fugh... Th-Thank you so much...!
That really wasn't like me at all, was it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How could I have ever doubted my love for my oshi...!
I'll run for my oshi! I'll get stronger for my oshi!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Even though that's Digi-tan's otaku way of life!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Thanks to you, I remembered something important...!

With renewed motivation,
Agnes Digital made a solid recovery.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Because I just love Umamusume so, so much!
"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna be a burden, but...!
I wanna watch you from closer than anyone else...!!
choice_data_list: Then let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: With that burning passion, you'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...! Passionate feelings...
If there's one thing I have absolute confidence in, it's the fiery passion in my chest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I'll run until I've burned through every last ounce of energy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, even if I'm burned to cinders, I'll ride the wind
and chase after my oshi anywhere!!
